WHAT'S THE SECRET TO LOOKING LIKE A NATURAL BLONDE?
Choose a hue that's within two shades of your natural hair color. Perfect 1O by Nice 'n Easy offers a palette of 10 beautiful blonde shades, making it simple to find the shade that's right for you. WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ASH BLONDE AND GOLDEN BLONDE?
Ash blonde is characterized by cooler beige tones. Warmer tones, such as rich honey or butter, create a perfectly golden-blonde look. I WOULD LOVE TO BE A REDHEAD, BUT HOW DO I SELECT A SHADE THAT BEST COMPLEMENTS MY SKIN TONE?
If you're fair, with blue or green eyes, complementary red shades abound. Cool copper, or even brighter, more vibrant tones, will suit your complexion. If you have dark or olive skin, opt for a darker auburn, or perhaps a chestnut color. Strawberry blonde looks best with a medium, warm complexion. ANY TIPS ON KEEPING BRASSINESS AT BAY?
Brassy hair is the number one complaint among my clients. Banish brassiness by weaving cooler beige or ash-tinted tones throughout your mane. WILL MY GRAY HAIRS ABSORB THE COLOR?
Clairol Perfect 1O offers 100% gray coverage, so your gray hairs stay under wraps. If stubborn gray hairs persist, leave the color on for an extra five minutes. HOW CAN I KEEP MY COLOR AS RICH AS AT THE SALON?
Not everyone can get their hair colored at a salon. For those of you who do, Perfect 1O by Nice 'n Easy extends the time between salon visits and gives your color an infusion of gloss and shine. THE SCIENCE OF PERFECT 10 HAIR COLOR

Perfect 10 is the first product to use Clairol's breakthrough formula, which works so efficiently that it does the job in just 10 minutes. The advanced color crème with micropearls allows for fast penetration into the hair fibers. The complete coloring process is accelerated and we can achieve high gloss color and 100% gray coverage in 10 minutes. WHAT IS A MICROPEARL?
Micropearls are the color molecules that exist within Perfect 10's advanced color crème formula.
